faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Yudhistir Mishra Law College recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Yudhistir Mishra Law College recruitment is 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Principal post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Principal post in the Yudhistir Mishra Law College recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for the Assistant Professor post is a Master's Degree in Law (LL.M.) with at least 55% marks or equivalent, along with NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. exemption.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the General category candidates?
faq.answer: For General category candidates, the application fee is Rs. 1500/- for the Principal post and Rs. 1000/- for the Assistant Professor post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on eligibility and academic score, followed by an interview before the Selection Committee and document verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit mentioned for the posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for the posts. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.answer: This recruitment is for posts located in Balangir, Odisha.
